page.overview:
What is Overtone?

The Overtone was a planet hopper captained by the Bivall bounty hunter Quin Carree of the Tempest Breakers, along with her partner Lourna Dee. The ship was provided to a motley team of Jedi and bounty hunters by the Villarandi information broker Kradon Minst, through Greyamina Tiss, as they prepared to track down the abducted Nihil Minister of Advancement Baron Boolan in the Nihil Occlusion Zone. It was equipped with a way to circumvent the Stormwall, allowing passage into the Occlusion Zone. Though the ship was modest and with some faulty components, it saw the team through their mission, including surviving the eternal storms of Heiklet and a dogfight with one of the Nihil's She'ar. Following the mission, the ship came under the ownership of Carree and Dee. The latter attempted to change its name to the Quin, but Carree refused to have a ship named after her. Journalist Rhil Dairo interviewed Lourna Dee from within the Overtone.

The Overtone first appeared in The High Republic: Tempest Breaker, a 2024 audio drama written by Cavan Scott and published as a part of the Star Wars: The High Republic multimedia project's Phase III. During the audio drama's flashbacks, the Overtone is described by Greyamina Tiss as a planet hopper. However, the drama's script, released in 2025, indicates in slug lines that the interview used as the frame story takes place in a Star Cruiser. In the dialogue of the final scene, Rhil Dairo confirms that they are in the Overtone. Given that the slug lines are out-of-universe, this article considers the descriptions of the ship in-universe to take precedence, especially as the ship is described more consistently with the typical size of a planet hopper instead of a Star Cruiser.
